heading_scope: Intrinsic-wave-spectrum integration; excludes quadratic wave/roll forcing and slow course-keeping excursions. Not total heading SD.
sway_surge_scope: Fixed linear horizontal transfer driven by the retained sampled wave, quadratic wave and prescribed roll forces; no nonlinear horizontal feedback closure.
roll_scope: Retained Gaussian equivalent linear roll, calibrated coefficients unchanged.
controller_scope: Borrowed published 5415M case 206 CFD/PF approximation; not the unknown experimental controller.
physical_validation_scope: Equivalent roll comparisons and two published heading peak RAOs; not validation of all four components over all routing conditions.
